commands.name: search-crates
commands.summary: Search or list crates by text query, with optional keyword/category/letter/user/team filters, sorting and pagination

commands.name: get-crate
commands.summary: Get a crate's details: description, links, download totals, keywords, categories and default version

commands.name: list-versions
commands.summary: List all published versions of a crate, with downloads, yanked status, license and MSRV

commands.name: get-version
commands.summary: Get details of one crate version: features, license, checksum, MSRV, edition, publisher

commands.name: list-dependencies
commands.summary: List the dependencies of a specific crate version, with version requirement, kind (normal/dev/build), optional flag and target

commands.name: list-reverse-dependencies
commands.summary: List crates that depend on a crate (dependents), sorted by the dependents' downloads

commands.name: get-crate-downloads
commands.summary: Get daily download counts for a crate over roughly the last 90 days, broken down by version id

commands.name: get-version-downloads
commands.summary: Get daily download counts for one specific crate version

commands.name: list-owners
commands.summary: List the owners (users and GitHub teams) of a crate

commands.name: get-readme
commands.summary: Get the rendered README (HTML) of a specific crate version

commands.name: list-source-files
commands.summary: List the files in a published crate version's source package, with sizes and sha256

commands.name: get-advisories
commands.summary: List RustSec security advisories (OSV format) affecting a crate

commands.name: get-docs-status
commands.summary: Check whether docs.rs built documentation successfully for a crate version

commands.name: get-user
commands.summary: Get a crates.io user's public profile (numeric id, name, GitHub link) by login

commands.name: get-team
commands.summary: Get a crate-owning GitHub team's profile (numeric id, name, org URL) by team login

commands.name: list-categories
commands.summary: List all crate categories with their slugs, descriptions and crate counts

commands.name: get-category
commands.summary: Get one category's details, including subcategories, parent categories and crate count

commands.name: list-keywords
commands.summary: List crate keywords with crate counts, sorted by popularity or alphabetically

commands.name: get-summary
commands.summary: Get the home-page summary: total crates and downloads, new, most-downloaded and just-updated crates, popular keywords and categories
